To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

trust in Web merchant is significantly related to intentions to purchase products via the Web, and this relationship is stronger than the relationships of other, more traditional perceived innovation characteristics.

trust in Web-based merchants is a significant determinant of intentions to use Web-based merchants, even when other perceived innovation characteristics (e.g., usefulness, ease of use, etc.) are considered.

trust in Web-based merchants is positively related (1) to intentions to make Web-based purchases, and (2) to intentions to use the Internet to purchase, even when the effects of other perceived innovation attributes are controlled.
In summary, our research is concerned with
identifying factors that may influence the adoption of a new technology.
identifying and understanding factors that may influence consumers' decisions to use e-commerce.
the factors that influence the adoption of web shopping, with particular focus on the impact of trust.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
consumers' trust in Web merchants has a positive and significant effect on intentions to use e-commerce to make a purchase, even when other factors such as perceived ease of use are considered.

the results of this study indicate that trust in web merchants is a critical factor in the decision to purchase from them via the Web, and this factor is significant even when other perceived innovation characteristics (e.g., usefulness, ease of use) are considered.

the adoption of Web-based shopping is positively influenced by trust in Web merchants, and that this relationship holds even when other perceived innovation characteristics, such as ease of use, are considered.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the more consumers trust a Web merchant, the more likely they are to purchase from that merchant, even when other perceptions about the Web-based shopping are considered.
trust is an important factor in consumers' decisions to make purchases via the Web.
trust is a critical component in consumers' decision to engage in Web shopping.
The main takeaway from our work is that
trust is the most important factor influencing consumers' intentions to purchase from Web merchants.
trust is a key factor in adoption and use of e-commerce.
trust is a key variable in the adoption of web based shopping.
